description: This header file declares utility functions for converting various BML data structures (such as nodes, statistics, and events) to string representations. It includes conditional inclusion of other definitions based on feature flags.

methods.name: bml_utils_node_to_string
methods.description: Converts a BML_NODE structure to its string representation. Writes the output into a provided buffer.

methods.name: bml_utils_stats_to_string
methods.description: Converts a BML_STATS structure to its string representation. Writes the output into a provided buffer.

methods.name: bml_utils_stats_to_string_raw
methods.description: Converts a BML_STATS structure to its raw (unformatted) string form. Writes the output into a provided buffer.

methods.name: bml_utils_event_to_string
methods.description: Converts a BML_EVENT structure to its string representation. Writes the output into a provided buffer.
